text: Oh, those whose intellects are purified by the discernment of the knowledge of Brahman achieve a truly difficult feat; for, being entirely free from desire, they renounce even the wealth meant for enjoyment. With firm conviction, they relinquish what was possessed in the past, what is possessed now, and what may be possessed in the future. Yet we are unable to completely renounce even the possessions that exist only as desires.
